title: Seeds
summary: A personal space to capture ideas, turn them into projects and keep next steps in view.
detail: The public demo shows quick capture, idea and project organization, a calendar, and views for connecting and resuming work. Personal contributions and technical decisions still need documentation.

title: HostiQR
summary: A QR-based digital reception for accommodations, with a private dashboard to manage the experience.
detail: The concept and dashboard access are visible in the public demo. The guest flow, personal contributions, technical decisions and results still need documentation.

title: FinTrack
summary: A financial tracking project presented as work in progress, without a confirmed public demo.
detail: This case study is ready to expand with the problem, personal contributions, technical decisions and results, without inventing facts.
